definitions.gloss: judicial system; judiciary; administration of justice
definitions.explanation: The system of courts and judges that interprets and applies the law.

examples.japanese: {司法|しほう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
{司法|しほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{立法|りっぽう}、⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧、{司法|しほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三権|さんけん}{分立|ぶんりつ}。
examples.english: Separation of the three powers: legislative, executive, and judicial.

notes:
{司法|しほう} refers to the judicial branch of government — the system of courts and judges that interprets and applies the law.

THREE BRANCHES OF GOVERNMENT ({三権|さんけん}{分立|ぶんりつ}):
- {立法|りっぽう}: legislative (makes laws)
- ⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧: executive (enforces laws)
- {司法|しほう}: judicial (interprets laws)

COMPOUNDS:
- {司法|しほう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: bar examination (the national exam to become a lawyer or judge)
- {司法|しほう}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: judicial system
- {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし}: judicial scrivener (a legal professional who handles documents)
- {司法|しほう}⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: plea bargain
- {司法|しほう}{権|けん}: judicial power

REGISTER:
A formal term used in legal, political, and news contexts. Not used in everyday conversation.
